text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, I spotted Mejiro Ardan
with numerous shopping bags resting at her feet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Just a quick break...
I wonder if I bought a bit too much...
choice_data_list: Those look heavy, can I help carry them?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, would you really?
Thank you so much. To be honest, my hands were at their limit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...!
You've truly saved me.

——Ah♪ There she is!
A~rdan-sa~~n!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer-san is with you too?
Hello~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we just happened to run into each other.
They were kind enough to carry my bags for me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Thank you very much
for assisting Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Um... It's not much of a reward, but
we're about to make some drinks. Would you
like to have some before you go?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, we're having a gathering where we all brought ingredients
to make healthy drinks together today~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Wait! What's with this massive amount of groceries!?
Did you get all of this yourself, Ardan-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: W-Was it really that much...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This is enough to withstand a castle siege!
For what reason did you procure so much...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Well... I found so many things that seemed
good for the two of you, and before I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
I've... always had a delicate constitution,
so I'm quite knowledgeable about dietary therapy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
I haven't had many chances to put that knowledge to use
for friends before, so I wanted to be of help...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It was all for our sake, then...
They must have been exceedingly heavy... I am deeply humbled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san, you aren't fond of liver, right?
So that you can still get your iron, I brought cocoa and Japanese mustard spinach.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh! You remembered that I can't stand liver?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And for Yaeno-san, some Greek yogurt♪
It's low-fat and high-protein, which is apparently wonderful for muscles and bones.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How did you know that I wished to strengthen not just my muscles, but my bones as well...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Giggle, fufufu...
I pay close attention to both of you, you see.
choice_data_list: That just shows how much she loves you two.
That just shows how much she loves you two.
She's certainly keeping tabs on her rivals.
She's certainly keeping tabs on her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Giggle, fufufu...
I pay close attention to both of you, you see.
choice_data_list: That just shows how much she loves you two.
That just shows how much she loves you two.
She's certainly keeping tabs on her rivals.
She's certainly keeping tabs on her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: L-L-L-Love...?! Did you say 'love'?!?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ That's kind of embarrassing to hear~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Yaeno-san! Why don't we come up with a recipe tailored just for Ardan-san too?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A splendid idea.
Ardan-san, do you have any dietary preferences or dislikes?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What kind of flavors do you like~?
Lemon? Milk? Something like a sports drink?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, the flavors I like?
...Fufu♪ Let me see—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the three spent harmonious time together whipping up drinks.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Love... huh. Ehehe, we feel the exact same way about you! Right, Yaeno-san?♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed! No, rather...
both of us feel that way toward Ardan-san...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: W-We love you very much!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, that is...! Please, I didn't mean it in th-that sort of way...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaahhhhh~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Y-Yaeno-san?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, everyone had to scramble and search for Yaeno Muteki, who had bolted in sheer embarrassment...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Rivals...! 
Indeed, that is precisely the case.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: D-Does that mean our weaknesses have already been scouted out completely~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu... there is a bit of that to it as well, yes♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Because we're rivals, we understand each other's strengths and weaknesses...
In other words, if I turned this into a proverb—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Send salt to enemies! Send cocoa to worthy rivals!"
That's what it means!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Um... I-I see...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan tilted her head at the bizarre proverb, but it seemed their mutual respect and feelings reached one another nonetheless.
